item.title: fix(package): bound installed worker artifact parsing (#126491)
item.summary: fix(package): bound installed worker artifact parsing (#126491) * fix(package): bound worker artifact parsing Keep canonical self-contained worker bundles above the generic dist-file cap while enforcing an 80 MiB limit before installed-package verification reads or parses them. * fix(package): bound every verifier read Route the context-engine and dependency scans through one root-dist pre-read policy, exclude plugin-owned extension assets from the root marker contract, and cover the public verifier flow.
